# DullyPDF

> PDF form automation for reusable fillable templates, spreadsheet/API filling, Fill By Link collection, and reviewed PDF output.

DullyPDF turns existing PDFs into reusable fillable templates using AI field detection. Teams upload a PDF, review detected fields, clean names and geometry in the editor, then fill the template from Excel, CSV, JSON, respondent submissions, or API calls. The current localized public SEO clusters are India under `/in/*` and Spanish under `/es/*`.

## India Homepage

- [DullyPDF India](https://dullypdf.com/in): English-language India homepage for KYC, vendor onboarding, HR joining, GST invoice, school, clinic, finance, branch, logistics, property, and procurement PDF automation.

## India Workflow Library

- [India PDF to Fillable Form](https://dullypdf.com/in/pdf-to-fillable-form): Convert recurring Indian PDFs into reviewed reusable templates.
- [Fill Indian PDF Forms From Excel Rows](https://dullypdf.com/in/fill-pdf-from-excel): Fill reviewed India templates from Excel rows.
- [India CSV to PDF Forms](https://dullypdf.com/in/fill-pdf-from-csv): Fill PDF templates from CSV exports and operational trackers.
- [India Fill By Link](https://dullypdf.com/in/fill-by-link): Collect respondent data through a web form before generating PDFs.
- [India PDF Fill API](https://dullypdf.com/in/pdf-fill-api): Send JSON to reviewed India templates and generate PDF output.
- [India PDF Packet Workflow](https://dullypdf.com/in/pdf-packet-workflow): Fill related PDF packets from one reviewed source record.

## Documentación

- [Primeros pasos](https://dullypdf.com/es/usage-docs/getting-started): Ruta desde subir un PDF hasta validar la primera salida rellenada.
- [Detección](https://dullypdf.com/es/usage-docs/detection): Confianza, geometría y revisión de campos detectados.
- [Flujo del editor](https://dullypdf.com/es/usage-docs/editor-workflow): Herramientas para mover, renombrar, cambiar tipos y guardar plantillas.
- [Renombrar y mapear](https://dullypdf.com/es/usage-docs/rename-mapping): Nombres de campos, columnas de datos y reglas de casillas/radios.
- [Search & Fill](https://dullypdf.com/es/usage-docs/search-fill): Relleno desde CSV, Excel, JSON o respuestas guardadas.
- [Fill By Link](https://dullypdf.com/es/usage-docs/fill-by-link): Publicación de formularios web y revisión de respuestas.
- [API Fill](https://dullypdf.com/es/usage-docs/api-fill): Endpoints JSON-a-PDF, esquemas, claves y límites.
- [Grupos](https://dullypdf.com/es/usage-docs/create-group): Paquetes de varios PDFs desde un mismo registro.
- [Imágenes y documentos](https://dullypdf.com/es/usage-docs/fill-from-images): Extracción con IA desde fotos, facturas, recibos o escaneos.
- [Guardar y descargar](https://dullypdf.com/es/usage-docs/save-download-profile): Plantillas guardadas, descargas, Profile y límites.
- [Solución de problemas](https://dullypdf.com/es/usage-docs/troubleshooting): Diagnóstico de detección, mapeo, relleno y salida.

## Plans

- **Free**: 5 saved forms, 5 detect pages, 50 fillable pages, 25 Fill By Link responses/month, 1 API endpoint (250 fills/month), 25 signing requests/month.
- **Premium**: 100 saved forms, 100 detect pages, 1,000 fillable pages, 10,000 Fill By Link responses/month, 20 API endpoints (10,000 fills/month), 10,000 signing requests/month.
